programme.title: Högskoleingenjörsutbildning i datateknik | Lunds universitet
programme.degree: Högskoleingenjörsexamen (computer engineering), 3 years, 180 hp — RELATED, not computer science
programme.how_found: lu.se programme listing 'Datateknik, IT och maskininlärning'.
programme.notes: Related, not the programme: Lund University has no bachelor titled Computer Science/Datavetenskap. The closest are Högskoleingenjörsutbildning i datateknik (TGDAT, Bachelor of Science in Engineering in Computer Engineering, 3 years, Swedish, LTH Helsingborg) and Systemvetenskapligt kandidatprogram (EGSYS, information systems); Civilingenjörsutbildning i datateknik (TADAT) is a 5-year 300 hp master-level engineering degree, not a bachelor. The answers below describe the related programme TGDAT (and Lund-wide rules), as dev5 did for related cases.

english.notes: Swedish-taught: the requirement is general eligibility (grundläggande behörighet, which includes Swedish and English at upper-secondary level); lu.se refers it to Antagning.se (not an official lu.se page), so no quote from an official domain. No English test minimum applies as such.

gpa.notes: Selection by grades (66%) and Högskoleprovet (34%); the page lists past admission scores (Höstterminen 2026: BI 17,17) — past-cycle results, not a published minimum.

deadline.quote: Sista anmälningsdag är normalt den 15 april inför höstterminen
deadline.notes: National admission round (Antagning.se) — the round a non-EU applicant uses for a Swedish-taught programme; no year printed ("normalt"), so for autumn 2027 this is 15 April 2027 unless the 15th is a holiday. TGDAT page itself: "Det finns inga tillfällen att söka till just nu".

value.population: citizens outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland

tuition.quote: Totalt pris för programmet/kursen: 555 000 kr Första betalningen: 92 500 kr
tuition.notes: Total programme price; first payment 92 500 kr, paid before each semester ("Avgiften betalas i en omgång i förväg inför varje termin"). Application fee 900 kr. Not converted to a yearly figure. Related programme TGDAT.

scholarship_exists.quote: You are applying in a regular application round to Master's level studies leading to a degree at Lund University, or, exceptionally, for one of the Bachelor's programmes in Development Studies, Mathematics, Physics and Physical Geography.
scholarship_exists.notes: Lund University Global Scholarship (non-EU fee payers, tuition only, merit-based) is open to bachelor applicants only for Development Studies, Mathematics, Physics and Physical Geography — not to the related TGDAT programme. No other university scholarship found for it.
